annotations.title: A journey run asked for with Run now: queued, running or finished, and its verdict

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/journeys/{journey}/requests/{id}. A journey run asked for with Run now: queued, running or finished, and its verdict. Poll this after asking for a run (every few seconds, as Retry-After says): `status` goes from queued to running to finished, and `run` then has the verdict.

id.description: the request's id, from the run's 202

journey.description: the journey's slug, as in its page's address /sites/{slug}/journeys/{journey}

name: sites_by_slug_journeys_by_journey_requests_by_id

data.description: A run asked for with Run now, and the run it made

finishedAt.description: when it finished (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

page.description: the journey's page on the dashboard

requestedAt.description: when it was asked for (ISO 8601, UTC)

chargeUsd.description: what the team was charged for it, US dollars (model cost plus the markup, at least the minimum); null when it wasn't charged

costUsd.description: what the model cost us, US dollars

id.description: the run's id, for /api/sites/{slug}/journeys/{journey}/runs/{id}; null for a request made before runs were linked

reached.description: whether the agent said it reached the goal

verdict.description: pass: reached the goal (and its checks agree); fail: didn't; inconclusive: couldn't be judged (blocked, stopped early)

run.description: the first model's run it made, once finished (the journey's other models run too: see /runs?model=); null before, or if it couldn't run (the journey budget, say)

startedAt.description: when the monitor started it (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

status.description: queued until the monitor starts it (within a minute), then running, then finished

statusUrl.description: where to check on it: GET this until status is finished

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: A journey run asked for with Run now: queued, running or finished, and its verdict
